reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x004AF75E was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004AF75E-Camera_ResetMatrix_30.cpp at sha256 1af2a8306936e40e7cff70b0c129e9977d69c863b9f4e2f124b954dbe74931d0 (recorded implementation.signature: void __stdcall Camera_ResetMatrix_30(void);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

retail_function.name: Camera_ResetMatrix_30
retail_function.summary: Six-byte import thunk 0x004AF75E: `jmp dword [0x533018]` to AVIFileExit; one block, no edges, no locals, no numeric constants.

candidate_function.summary: The candidate file defines `AVIFileExit` with AVIFileExit's own prototype and the body `return AVIFileExit();`, i.e. a self-recursive call to itself.

divergences: Candidate defines AVIFileExit itself and tail-calls AVIFileExit, turning the retail IAT thunk (jmp dword [0x533018]) into an infinite self-call.
The record's declared function Camera_ResetMatrix_30 is never defined in the candidate; only the import name is defined.
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x004AF75E is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/camera/004AF75E-Camera_ResetMatrix_30.cpp (sha256 1af2a8306936e40e7cff70b0c129e9977d69c863b9f4e2f124b954dbe74931d0). Six-byte import thunk 0x004AF75E: `jmp dword [0x533018]` to AVIFileExit; one block, no edges, no locals, no numeric constants. Candidate: The candidate file defines `AVIFileExit` with AVIFileExit's own prototype and the body `return AVIFileExit();`, i.e. a self-recursive call to itself.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Binary Ninja models 0x004AF75E with the imported routine's prototype (AVIFileExit); the candidate's record signature is Camera_ResetMatrix_30's prototype but the file defines `AVIFileExit` with the import's prototype, so the declared record function is not the function the file defines.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail forwards the caller's frame unchanged through the IAT slot 0x533018; the candidate's `AVIFileExit()` takes the import's parameter list and passes it to itself.

checks.name: control_flow_shape
checks.detail: Binary Ninja and radare2 agree on 1 blocks / 0 edges (similarity 1.000); angr CFGFast recovers 1 blocks with has_unresolved_jumps=false.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail has exactly one indirect jump to the IAT entry 0x533018 (AVIFileExit); the candidate calls AVIFileExit, which it itself defines, so the call never reaches the import.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Single relocatable constant: the IAT slot 0x533018.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: No stack locals and no global writes; the only memory access is the IAT pointer load performed by the jmp.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns AVIFileExit's EAX/EDX unchanged because the jmp forwards the callee's return; the candidate never reaches the real body and cannot return its value.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "void __stdcall()" at 0x004AF75E; radare2 recovers "void sub.AVIFIL32.dll_AVIFileExit ();". Both tools place the entry at 0x004AF75E and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: void __stdcall Camera_ResetMatrix_30(void);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.

limitations: No game process was executed; this review is static (live Binary Ninja, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast) plus the candidate source.
The catalog name Camera_ResetMatrix_30 is a harvest label for the import thunk at 0x004AF75E; the real retail identity is the IAT forwarder to AVIFileExit.
